plan.authorization: User authorized bounded pilot and notes; supersedes analysis-only pause for this pilot
plan.scored_interval: original eight windows; all original references unchanged
plan.boundary_policy: Model may see surrounding frames; only predictions in original closed interval scored; context predictions retained separately; references use frozen original IDs
plan.price_estimate_note: Historical conservative10/30 USD per million,not invoice rates
plan.detection: CPU serial,1280 input,classes person0 andsportsball32,confidence0.20; highest confidence ball per frame gives512px square native-source crop,clamped to image; no ball=no crop; no label-derived ROI
plan.prompt_change: Identical instructions acrossarms; add core/context scope and max12events to shareddirectprompt; image manifest maps timestamp/view to each image. This is a newcontext-controlledbaseline,not a purecomparisonwith012. Outputcap1536 in allarms allows largerimage evidence responses.
hypotheses: ballcrops improve ball visibility over same12wideframes
plan.failure_policy: Stop an arm on actual transport/schema/truncation failure,no retries; independent arms may still run. Spend failure stops wholepilot. Save raw before validation. Memorypressure observed only.
plan.compatibility_change: six image sheets;each contains two timestamped rows;wide768x432 left,optional native512crop right;eachrow1280x552;canvas1280x1104 identical acrossarms
plan.reuse_policy: For six windows with no crops,identical dense-arm prompt/imagehash outputs are reused explicitly;only2cropwindows generate fresh calls. Not independent repeats.
plan.comparison: Dense sheets vs crop sheets controls canvas and rowpositions;013wide6 baseline is historical input-strategy comparison,not a pure frame-count ablation.
plan.failure_evidence: 013dense12 andcrop16 attachments rejected withBadRequestError; exact serverreason notretained,so imagemaxnotestablished.014uses6attachments alreadyaccepted,with improved safeerror capture.
